gameDescriptionHtml:
Squirrel, here’s a gun for you. You are the most obnoxious rodent in the area, and in pursuit of golden acorns you will commit a crime. In this sandbox shooter and puzzle platformer, you have to fight with teeth, claws and bullets to escape from a secret underground facility and defeat the Agents.

Game Features

  • Fight with teeth, claws and bullets – Find out what a crazy squirrel with a gun in his paws is capable of (the paws themselves are enough) and what this fluffy villain is ready to do for the sake of acorns. You have to escape from a secret underground facility and defeat the Agents. Upgrade your weapons and search for other secret bunkers to defeat elite bosses. You can even blow up a tank. Change weapons and try your hand at fighting enemies – 12 types are available.
  • Solve challenging puzzles and collect golden acorns – Solve unique puzzles, inventively using your arsenal of weapons and the recoil effect to collect all the golden acorns. After collecting enough acorns, you can unlock hidden levels of the game.
  • Enjoy this sandbox game – Explore the world through the eyes of a squirrel or conquer the surroundings by driving around in a toy car. You can both frighten the neighbors and ask passers-by to pet you. Help them in exchange for nice things (or just rob them) and unlock cosmetics to develop your own style.
